port.description: LDAP service port (standard non-TLS LDAP port).

ssl_port.description: LDAPS (TLS) service port. Set to 0 to disable.

max_descriptors.description: Maximum number of file descriptors the server may open.

size_limit.description: Maximum number of entries returned in a search operation.

time_limit.description: Maximum duration (seconds) for a search operation.

enable_access_log.description: Enable access logging to a dedicated file.

access_log_path.description: Path to the access log file (used only if access logging is enabled).

enable_audit_log.description: Enable audit logging (records all changes to entries).

audit_log_path.description: Path to the audit log file (used only if audit logging is enabled).

error_log_path.description: Path to the error log file.

base_suffix.description: Suffix (base DN) for the directory tree (e.g., dc=example,dc=com).

root_password.description: Encrypted root DN password (e.g., {SSHA}hash). Required for initial setup. In production, generate via dsconf or ldapmodify.

backends.description: List of backend databases (suffixes). Each entry defines a database instance.

replication_enabled.description: Enable replication with another Directory Server instance.

replication_host.description: Hostname of the replication partner (used if replication enabled).

replication_port.description: LDAP port of the replication partner.

replication_bind_dn.description: DN used for replication bind operation (must exist on both servers).

replication_credentials.description: Password for the replication bind DN.

replication_agreements.description: List of replication agreements (for multi-master or hub/leaf setups).

password_history_count.description: Number of previous passwords to remember (prevents reuse).

password_check_syntax.description: Enforce password complexity rules (length, character types).

password_max_failure.description: Failed login attempts before account lockout.

password_lockout_enabled.description: Enable account lockout on repeated failures.

password_lockout_duration.description: Lockout duration in seconds before automatic unlock.

password_unlock_enabled.description: Allow manual password unlock via LDAP operation.

schemas.description: Additional schema files to load (e.g., custom objectClasses).

enabled_plugins.description: List of plugins to enable with configuration.

hostname.description: Server's hostname or FQDN. Used for internal identification.

backend_encryption.description: Enable encryption of backend files (requires FIPS mode on RHEL/CentOS).

backend_encryption_cipher.description: Cipher algorithm for backend encryption (e.g., AES256-CBC).

backend_encryption_pbkdf2.description: PBKDF2 hash function for encryption key derivation (e.g., SHA256).

schema_file.description: Path to the LDIF schema file.

plugin_path.description: Path to the plugin shared library (if not built-in).

plugin_args.description: Plugin-specific arguments (key-value pairs or bare strings).
